description: Ladogual wears a full-length dark forest-green textured gown with a low square neckline, structured fitted bodice and elbow-length outer sleeves. Gold-tan knotwork borders decorate the bodice, neckline, skirt front, hem and sleeve bands. A cream underlayer appears at the sleeves and lower center of the skirt. A broad decorated belt with round metal buckle defines the waist. A matching green wrap with cream lining and knotwork edging hangs loosely from the shoulders and arms, secured by two round brooches near the shoulders. A small ring is visible, and dark closed shoes show below the hem. Fabrics appear wool-like over linen-like cloth, with actual fiber uncertain.
